ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 65%) on lobes contrasted with low-intensity dark pixels (approx. 35%) concentrated at the central peduncle area and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the majority of both lobes. A central, low-intensity dark region extends from the peduncle into the notch. Fine-scale dark mottling and focal spots are distributed across the white surfaces, including a prominent vertical linear mark on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 105 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits consistent small-scale peaks and valleys. Right lobe displays more pronounced indentations and irregular spacing of serrated elements near the lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve along the trailing edge sweeping from the median notch to the lateral tips; outer leading edges (partially obscured by water) suggest a convex upward curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular tan-white pixel aggregates (barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the medial-posterior region of the right lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters on distal tips of both lobes; visible vertical linear scars/rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bifurcation of the dark pigmentation pattern where it meets the median notch, creating a distinct pixel boundary.
